Definition: from G5034; curt, i.e. impending:--shortly, swift.
BiblicalUsage: Peter says the putting off of his tabernacle is at hand, shortly, as the Lord Jesus has shown him. Then he warns that false teachers will bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord, and bring upon themselves swift destruction. The word is short, soon, impending: his own death is near, and their judgment will not be slow.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Peter writes the way a man writes when he knows his time is short: plainly, urgently, and with no patience for lies.
